fuel_consumption.source_quote: Inclusive of the operations of AirTran, the Company expects to consume approximately 1.9 billion gallons of jet fuel in 2012.

instrument_type_details.notes: Primarily a mixture of purchased call options, collar structures (purchased call + sold put), call spreads (purchased call + sold call), and fixed-price swap agreements. WTI crude oil, Brent crude oil, and refined products (heating oil, unleaded gasoline) used as hedge underlyings. Includes fuel derivative instruments acquired from AirTran.

warnings: Net fair value of -$44M is gross fair value (before cash collateral netting); an additional $226M in cash collateral was provided by the Company to three counterparties. Note 10 labels this as 'gross fair value' explicitly.

2012 gallons (111M) are very low because coverage for early 2012 is minimal; table is inclusive of AirTran fuel derivatives acquired at acquisition. Percentage of consumption not disclosed for forward years in this filing.
